split_policy: Use verified source manifest capture_session_id splits unchanged; generated UI patches inherit source frame split
positives: Each verified clear card: exact crop plus two bounded outward-padded variants, no rank/suit class supplied to verifier
negatives: Nonoverlapping annotated seat/pot/action-button regions plus 12 separately generated controls/background patches per source frame
crop_encoding: RGB, aspect-preserving thumbnail in 48x64 black canvas; no inferred role/card identity used
limitations: Source images are session-disjoint; shared synthetic styles and potentially repeated simple background patch pixels are not independent real-domain validation. Recipe is not the full-table annotation manifest schema.
